title: IS12:: sumarfunc.c (10.2)

lines.explanation: It is a common wat to define dimensions of all arrays used in the program as symbolic constants
The array testarray is defined outside of any funcion. It means that it is a global array. It is accessible from any function in this program (here - from both main() amd summarray()
This is a function prototype. It tells that funcion summarray() has no parameters and returns an integer value.
The execution of any program starts with function main
This for loop reads N integer values from the standard input and places them into the global arrat testarray.

The call is sumarray() function is simply an expression. This expression has an integer value. However, to calculate this value the function sumarray() is called. The value returned by the return operator of sumarray() will be the value of the expression.
This is the header of sumarray()
Variables i and sum are local variables in sumarray(). They are not accessible from main()
This loop simply summs up all elements of the array into the variable sum
Return operator ends the function. The value of the expression in this operator is called the returned value. It will be passed to the calling function.
